_README: REAL EXTRACTION - TRANCHE 7. Closes the last three coverage candidates.
1. CLOSING FRAME (paras 218-235) - always-emitting modifier on letter_shell, three segments.
The opening shell covered the top of the letter only; the assembler needs the bottom too.
2. TENANTS IN COMMON modifier - re-sent; it was lost when I patched tranche 6.
3. CONTAMINATED SITES (para 162) - NOT clause language. An ALL-CAPS instruction with no brackets,
never emitted. Modeled as a position with NO body that raises three attachment/task
requirements when the site is or may be contaminated. If a body-less position is not
loadable, tell me and I will re-key it as clause-level guidance plus a director question.
OPEN QUESTION FOR MIKE (flagged on sig_tenant_title): the template signs 'Store Development
Manager'. Powder Springs and Douglasville both instead use 'Representative Name / Representative
Title: Broker' with the Store Development Manager cc'd. Confirm which is the Oculus standing
default before the acceptance test runs - the emitted signature block will differ.

canonical_bodies.body_text: Please sign below if the terms described in this Letter of Intent are acceptable to you. This LOI is subject to approval by Starbucks senior leadership, and there may be significant delays between the date the letter of intent is signed and the date the first draft of a lease is generated by Starbucks. This Letter of Intent is non-binding, except as expressly stated herein. It will be superseded by, and the parties will only be bound by, the terms of a written lease agreement, in form and substance satisfactory to both parties, which has been fully executed and delivered by the parties. The lease document will contain a provision allowing for electronic or digital signatures, which electronic or digital signatures will be deemed binding by the parties. Until and unless the parties mutually execute a lease, either party may terminate the negotiations contemplated herein at any time, for any reason, and without liability or further obligation (except in regards to its confidentiality obligation) to the other party, by providing written notice of termination to the other party. Notwithstanding the nonbinding nature of this Letter of Intent, Landlord acknowledges that Starbucks deems each of the terms of this Letter of Intent as material terms that serve as the basis for Starbucks’ decision to move forward with lease negotiations and that (i) any subsequent demands by Landlord for deviations from the terms of this Letter of Intent or (ii) delays in providing documentation specified herein or as further requested by Starbucks, may result in significant delays and a termination of lease negotiations.
canonical_bodies.extraction_note: Source carries '[DELETE PRECEDING SENTENCE IF NOT USING STARBUCKS STANDARD FORM LEASE]'. That is a cross-clause dependency on the Lease clause: the preceding sentence is dropped when L1 (landlord's form) is selected instead of L0. Represented as an applies_when on the position rather than inline text.

clauses.description: Contaminated-sites escalation. Template para 162 is an ALL-CAPS instruction with no brackets - never emitted. It is a DUE-DILIGENCE ESCALATION, not clause language, so it lands as an attachment/task requirement plus guidance, not a body.
clauses.guidance_note: FOR CONTAMINATED OR POTENTIALLY CONTAMINATED SITES (SUCH AS FORMER GAS STATIONS OR DRY CLEANERS), ADDITIONAL DUE DILIGENCE WILL BE REQUIRED AS WELL AS DETAILED LANDLORD OBLIGATIONS REGARDING COMPLETION OF REMEDIATION PLANS AND FINANCIAL SECURITY TO COMPLETE SUCH REMEDIATION. NEVER emitted.

positions.internal_note: Emits NOTHING - it exists to raise the due-diligence obligation as a wizard task when the site is or may be contaminated. Paired with the existing on-deviation approval flag on the hazmat standing default.

attachment_requirements.requirement: Additional environmental due diligence required (site is or may be contaminated - e.g. former gas station or dry cleaner).
Detailed Landlord obligations regarding completion of remediation plans.
Financial security from Landlord sufficient to complete remediation.

applies_when.note: raise the due-diligence tasks when the site is or may be contaminated
